tei:titleStmt.tei:title: (207)༄༅༅/ /dpal ldan shangs pa'i gser chos las/rtsa ba ni gu chos drug gi khrid bsdus stan thog gcig ma'i nyams len ye shes ḍā ki'i zhal lung zhes bya
(207)༄༅༅/ /dpal ldan shangs pa'i gser chos las/rtsa ba ni gu chos drug gi khrid bsdus stan thog gcig ma'i nyams len ye shes ḍā ki'i zhal lung zhes bya

tei:div.tei:p: "$ (207)༄༅༅// dpal ldan shangs pa'i gser chos las/ rtsa ba ni gu chos drug gi khrid bsdus stan thog gcig ma'i nyams len ye shes ḍā ki'i zhal lung zhes bya ba bzhugs so/// /

(208)༄༅// brtan g.yo'i khyab bdag bde ba che// gcig pu'i rang bzhin du ma'i gzugs// zab mo'i rim pa las skyes pa// bla med de la phyag 'tshal lo// rgyud rnams kun las dngos bstan cing*// grub mchog bye ba gshegs pa'i shul// nyams su blangs pas ye shes ster// chos drug stan thog gcig ma 'chad// de yang mthar thug ston pa rnam lnga sogs bla med kyi rgyud sde mtha' dag gi rdzogs rim snying por dril ba ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro'i zhal lung las rtsod med du byung zhing*/ mkhas grub khyung po rnal 'byor sogs skye mtha'i byang sems 'ba' zhig pa'i thugs bcud smar chos drod tshad yid ches 'phral du skyed pa 'di nyid rgyas par yig rnying rnams dang*/ khyad par rje btsun sgrol ba'i mgon po'i gsung rab las shes par bya zhing*/ stan thog gcig ma'ang de nyid dang dam pa'i skyes bu gzhan gyi yig cha mang du mchis mod/ 'dir de dag gi zab bcud dril zhing brgyud pa rnying pa la bka' (209)bab kyi gdams ngag gsar pas zur brgyan te bshad par bya'o// spyir sgo 'byed dang byin rlabs kyi bka' rnams thob cing rtsa ba'i chos bzhi'i myong ba ci rigs skyes pa'am/ ma skyes kyang khrid chen rdzogs pa zhig gis rgyun khyer nyams len tu bya ba ni 'di yin no// de la spyi dang khyad par gnyis/ spyi la sngon 'gro dang dngos gzhi gnyis/ sngon 'gro la'ang thun mong dang thun min gnyis so// thun mong spyi la grags pa'i chos bzhis rgyud sbyangs pa sngon du song ba'i dbang du byas nas 'dir gsal 'debs khyug tsam bya ste/ gnas dben par stan bde bar lus gnad dkyus mthun bca'/ dal brgyad 'byor bcus brgyan pa'i mi lus yid bzhin nor bu las kyang ches rnyed par dka' ba 'di yang 'chi rkyen du mas mi rtag pas de ring tsam yang mi 'chi ba'i gding ni med/ shi nas dkar nag las kyi 'bras bu kho na dbang che zhing*/

mkha' khyab kyi sems can rnams kyang 'khor ba'i (210)sdug bsngal dar drags la yun ring bas gtses/ sdug bsngal 'di las skyob thub pa'i skyabs kyi rgyal po ni bla ma rin po che yin pas khyed las re sa med do snyam pa'i blo thag rbad kyis bcad/ chos 'di'i rang lugs kyi thun mong gi sngon 'gro dngos ni skyabs 'gro sems bskyed gnyis te/ dang po ni/ sa phyogs dag pa'i zhing khams su mos/ mdun gyi nam mkhar seng khri sna tshogs padma nyi zla bzhi brtsegs pa'i steng du drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma sku dngos de ka la bkrag mdangs gzi brjid 'od du 'bar ba/ rang la dgyes pa'i 'dzum zhal gyis gzigs pa/ phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi dkon mchog rtsa gsum ma lus pa 'dus pa'i bdag nyid du nges shes bskyed la/ bla ma rang mkhyen snyam pa'i blo gtad ling gis bskyur/ nam mkha'i mtha' khyab kyi pha ma sems can kun kyang rang dang lhan cig skyabs su 'gro bar mos te/ ngag tu/ ma nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad skyabs kun 'dus kyi ngo bo bla ma rin po che la skyabs su mchi ba lags so// zhes ci nus brjod/ skyabs yul skabs 'dir bsdu bar mi mdzad/ gnyis pa ni/ sems can thams cad bdag gi pha mar ma gyur pa ni gcig kyang med pas shin tu gces shing phongs kyang 'khor ba na sdug bsngal mtha' med pa la spyod par 'dug /'di rnams la drin lan tu phan gdags dgos/ de yang phan phyogs res mi phyin pas thams cad zung 'jug rdo rje 'chang chen po'i go 'phang la 'god pa'i phyir du snyan brgyud kyi thabs lam bsgom par bgyi'o snyam pa'i blo dung dung bas/ ngag tu/ nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyi don du rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa (211)rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i ched du zab lam ni gu'i chos drug nyams su blang bar bgyi'o// zhes yang yang brjod/ dkon mchog skyabs 'og chud pa dang*// skyes bu chen po'i blo skyes na// thar pa'i lam las mi zlog cing*// spyod lam kun kyang byang chub rgyu/

༈ /sngon 'gro gnyis pa thun mong ma yin pa dag byed a'i stong ra ni/ sngar bsgoms pa'i rtsa ba'i bla ma nyid slar yang gsal gdab ste mos gus kyi gdung shugs drag pos/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i ngo bo bla ma rin po che/ sems can thams cad kyi don du bdag gis nad gdon thams cad zhi bar mdzad du gsol/ sdig sgrib thams cad 'dag par mdzad du gsol/ ting nge 'dzin khyad par can rgyud la skye bar mdzad du gsol/ zhes gsol ba ci nus su btab pas bla ma 'od du zhu/ spyi bo nas zhugs te thim pas klad pa gti mug gi rang bzhin can de sbyangs nas yal/ mgrin pa yan chad mgo bo chu'i lbu ba lta bu kha dog dkar la reg bya srab pa'i nang du chos 'byung dkar po gru gsum pa dwangs gsal shel gyi snod lta bu/ rtsa ba phra ba mgrin par sleb cing gdengs ka g.yal ba gyen tu bstan pa'i zur gcig smin dbrag dang*/ zur gnyis rna ltag g.yas g.yon la reg tsam pa/ de'i dbus su drang thad du bla ma dang rang sems skye med mtshon pa'i a dkar po gsal dwangs 'od kyi rang bzhin can/ phyed cha chos 'byung nang du chud cing phyed tsam steng du 'thon pa/ rten med du lding ba la thog mar bsgrims te sems gtad/ de rjes shes pa grims lhod (212)ran pos ci nus sems 'dzin/ mi nus na a thung gi bzlas pa shubs bur lan nyer gcig tsam bzlas pas/ a yig las bdud rtsi dkar po'i rgyun shugs dang ldan par bab/ chos 'byung mer gyis gang ste zham zham lud pas lus phyi nang thams cad du khyab cing bkrus/ thog med nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib bag chags dkor dang sku glud zos pa dam tshig nyams chags sogs dud khu sol khu'i rnam par ba spu'i bu ga dang dbang po'i sgo rnams nas phyir nag nu ru ru bdas/ lus kyi gdos bcas ljan ljin rnams kyang zhu ba ltar song zhing bdud rtsis phyi nas kyang bkrus te nag bun nu nu sa 'og thag ring por song nas yal/

rang lus shel gong g.ya' dag pa la thogs med 'ja' dkar po lta bu bdud rtsis gang bar bsams la shes pa lhod la bzhag /'di nyid ched du bsgom skabs dmigs bzlas de rnams bskyar ba yin la bla ma'i rnal 'byor thog ma'i gcig des chog /dmigs pa 'di la yan lag gnyis te nad zhi byed ni/ tsha ba la bdud rtsi dkar bsil gyis nad dmar po'i rnam pa/ grang ba la bdud rtsi dmar zhing tsha bas nad dkar 'dur gyi rnam pa/ rlung dam 'dus pa la bdud rtsi ser la snum pas nad sngo 'dur gyi rnam pa sogs/ gang na ba'i thad de kar bug pa byung nas bdas pas rtsad nas dag par bsam/ gdon zhi byed ni/ a las bab pa'i bdud rtsi gdon so so'i gnyen po khro bo ser drag lta bur gyur pa dang*/ me dpung dang khro chu khol ma'i rgyun sngags kyi sgra dang bcas pas lhag med du tshar bcad bar bsgom la mnyam par bzhag go /sbyang bya gdod nas ma grub par// sbyong byed skye med yig 'bru nyid// spros pa kun zhi (213)dbu ma'i don// sbyong tshul kun gyi zla med pa'o/ ༈ /dngos gzhi chos drug gi dang pa thabs lam bde drod rang 'bar la sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes gsum mo// sngon 'gro lus gnad me'i stong ra'am gtum mo me rgod ma ni/ rang bde mchog lhan skyes su gsal ba'am tha mal du'ang rung ba'i spyi bor seng ge brgyad kyis btegs pa'i rin po che'i khri yangs shing rgya che ba'i steng du padma dkar po dang nyi zla'i steng du rtsa ba'i bla ma ston zla ltar dkar zhing zhal 'dzum bag can/ rang la byin gyis rlob rlob 'dra ba bsgom/ log rtog shas che ba dang mos blos yar gzhal dgos tshe rdo rje 'chang du bsgoms kyang rung ni rung*/ chos drug 'di'i khyad chos su bla ma sku dngos sgom par mdzad/ gong ltar skyabs gnas kun 'dus su mos pa sogs sgo du ma nas mos gus kyi gdung shugs drag pos/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i ngo bo bla ma rin po che/

sems can thams cad kyi don du bdag gi lus la bde drod kyi ting nge 'dzin khyad par can skye bar mdzad du gsol/ sems la bde stong gi ting nge 'dzin khyad par can skye bar mdzad du gsol/ ces gsol ba drag tu btab pas bla ma bdud rtsi'i ngo bor zhu ba spyi bo nas thim/ rnam smin gyi lus sbyangs te rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor mar gyur pa ni/ dmar smug zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas rdo rje// cung zad 'thur sdigs thod khrag thugs kar g.yon// thod skam dbu rgyan thod rlon do shal 'phyangs// spyan gsum skra grol phyag rgya lnga yis brgyan// g.yas brkyang stabs kyis pad nyi mi ro dkar// mgo g.yas bstan steng me phung dbus na bzhugs// sku lus (214)kyi nang dar dmar gyi gur phub pa lta bu ba spu'i mthar thug pa tshun stong sang nge bar bsam/ lus gnad me thab drug chings bya ste tsog pu rkang ngar g.yas nang g.yon pa phyi la yod pa'i re'u mig ltar bsnol/ lag gnyis kyang bsnol te bar lhu gnyis 'jus pa'i gru mo pus mo'i steng du yong par bya/ sgal tshigs bsrangs/ lta stangs thad kar bzhag /lte ba'i thad kyi mdun rgyab gnyis dang mkhal khung g.yas g.yon dang bzhir me'i gong bu dmar la zlum pa/ shin tu tsha ba/ me lce 'bar tshad pa lcags sregs gong bu lta bu bzhi sgroms su gsal gdab/ dmigs rdil de mi 'dor bzhin tu rlung ro dal la ring ba lan gsum 'bud/ steng rlung dal bus rngubs te lte 'og tu mnan/ 'og rlung yar mi 'then par rang sar bcings/ lte bar g.yas bskor gcig dang g.yon bskor gcig byas pas me gong rnams 'thabs te lus kyi nang thams cad me stags dmar skyas dmar chem chem tsha 'ur 'ur khyab par bsam la mi bde ba med med du 'jam rlung bzung*/ mi thub pa na dang por shugs chung*/ bar du che/ mthar sang gis bus/ de ltar bzhi brgyad sogs rlung theng gang lcogs bzung*/

cung zad byang nas g.yas bskor g.yon bskor re re rim par bsnan pas mthar bskor ba bcu gnyis re tsam thub pa na me'i nus pa rnyed par 'gyur zhing*/ yan lag lnga sbyong sngon tu 'gro ba'i gtsubs shing gtsubs stan ma'i 'khrul 'khor yang ci nus byas pas drod skye ba la myur ro// dngos gzhi gtum mo zas su za ba ni/ lus gnad rkang pa sems dpa'i skyil krung lhod de rgya che bar bca'/ lag pa bsrangs te lag mthil gnyis pus mor bkab/ so mchu rang bab lta ltangs gong mtshungs/ sgal tshigs bsrang*/ (215)rkang pa'i mthe bong nang du dgug /rang nyid rje btsun mar gsal ba'i stong ra'i dbus su rtsa a ba dhū ti mda' smyug 'bring po tsam drang ba/ srab pa/ dwangs pa/ dmar ba ste mtshan nyid bzhi ldan/ yar sne tshangs bug dang mar sne lte 'og sor bzhir zug pa/ gnyis ka'ang bcad khar yod cing nang stong sang nge ba smyug ma khrigs bcad byas pa lta bu'i g.yas su ro ma dmar po// g.yon tu rkyang ma dkar po gnyis ka gro sog tsam pa bcas sum gshib las/ mar sne dbu ma las sor bzhi ring bar song ba'i sne yar log ste dbu ma'i nang du chud tsam pa/ yar sne gnyis po dbu ma'i yar sne'i rgyab phyogs nas sor gcig tsam thad du 'khyogs/ de mtshams gnyis gshibs byas pas dbu ma'i yar sne'i steng nas bkab cing mdun tu gug nas sna bug gnyis su thug pa/ dbu ma'i yar sna'i nang du haṃ yig dkar po mgo thur bstan bde zhing bsil ba/ mas sna rtsa gsum 'dus mdor raṃ yig dmar po mgo gyen bstan shin tu tsha ba/ de las sor bzhi tsam gyi 'og thad bshang sgor rlung gi dkyil 'khor zla gam sngo skya bcad kha mdun bstan rab tu g.yo ba rnams gsal btab/ 'bud pa dgu phrugs ni/ dang po dal la ring ba gsum/ de nas drag la thung ba gsum/ de nas ro stod gcud cing 'bud pa gsum ni/ lag pa g.yas pa'i mthe bong srin lag gis mnan cing mthe'u chung yang bkug

/mdzub mo gung mo'i rgyab tu sbyar bas sna g.yon pa btsir/ g.yon mthe bong nang du bcug pa'i khu tshur mchan 'og g.yas par bcug pa g.yas kyi bar lhus mnan te g.yas kyi nu ma gru mo gcud la bor zhing sna g.yas nas rlung ro lan gcig sang gis 'bud/ de go zlog (216)pas g.yon nas gcig /slar yang g.yas nas gcig 'bud la cung zhig ngal gso zhing stong ra gsal gdab/ yang dal bus rlung ro gcig bsal nas steng rlung 'jam por rngubs pa lte 'og tu mnan/ 'og rlung yang cung zad 'then la kha sbyor du bzung*/ dmigs pa rlung rnams sna sgo nas ro rkyang brgyud nas rtsa gsum 'dus mdor sleb/ rlung dkyil las kyang rlung kha dog sngon po mdud tshugs su langs te dbu mar chud/ rlung gsum pos raṃ bus pas me phra zhing rno ba gsal la 'tsher ba je ring 'bar/ rlung theng 'ga' re song nas spyi bo'i haṃ la phog pas byang sems dkar po'i rgyun bab/ je ring byung nas lte ba'i raṃ la thim par bsgom/ de'ang mdun phyogs su me dang rgyab phyogs su thig le'i 'bar 'dzag bya ste shas che ba la dgongs pa yin gsungs/ me 'od gang du byung ba'i lus kyi nang tsha 'ur ba dang*/ byang sems kyi 'od skya yam gang du byung ba der bde phril gyis byung ba gnyis la 'dun pa res mos gtad/ de'ang rlung ji tsam thub thub tu bzung zhing cung zad mi bde na sngon ma phyir ma btang bar slar yang rngub chung gang nus bcas lte ba'i g.yas g.yon dbus gsum du 'then gnon byas te gzhil/ mi thub na gong ltar 'phang*/ de ma thag tu yang rngubs te bsgom/ ngal gso na rlung theng bzhi/ brgyad/ bcu drug la sogs pa'i mtshams su bya yi gang 'dod du bzhag mi rung*/ nyin mtshan gyi mtha' dang gung gnyis la spang zhing thog mar g.yon nam mnyam rgyu'i skabs su bzung ba'i 'go brtsam pa dang*/ dud rlung sogs spang blang bya ba rnams kyang gzhan las shes par bya'o// rjes srid pa'i dbang zhu ba ni/

bla ma gdan bcas gong ltar gsal gdab/ phyi mchod phyogs dus kun gyi mchod rdzas bzang dgu/ nang dam tshig dang ye shes kyi bdud rtsi/ gsang ba bde (217)skyed kyi rig ma/ 'khor gsum sgyu ma rmi lam ltar shes pa de kho na nyid de mchod pa bzhi rdzogs su phul bar bsam zhing*/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i ngo bo bla ma rin po che la/ phyi me tog bdug spos/ nang sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga/ gsang ba bde stong gi ye shes/ yang gsang de kho na nyid kyi mchod pa dam pa rnams 'bul lo// bzhes nas bdag la dbang bzhi rdzogs par bskur du gsol// zhes gsol ba drag tu btab pas// bla ma'i sku las ye shes bdud rtsi dkar la bde ba'i ngad can bab/ spyi bo nas zhugs/ smin mtshams yan chad gang*/ lus kyi dri ma dag /bum dbang thob/ mgrin pa yan chad gang*/ ngag gi dri ma dag /gsang dbang thob/ snying ga yan chad gang*/ yid kyi dri ma dag /shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob/ lus thams cad gang*/ sgo gsum gyi dri ma mtha' dag dag /dbang bzhi pa thob/ bla ma 'od du zhu nas rang la thim/ bla ma'i gsang gsum dang rang gi sgo gsum dbyer med du mos la mnyam par bzhag /'di nyid dgos pa dang byin rlabs shin tu che bas skabs 'dir tshar re chag thabs med cing khol 'don phur tshugs su bsgom na bogs 'don thams cad kyi mchog go /stod smad kyi gegs rang grol sogs ni gzhung las shes par bya'o// bde stong phyag rgya chen po'i dngos// skye 'di nyid la myur ster ba// tsaṇḍi rgyal ba kun gyi thugs// bsags sbyangs kun gyi mthar thug go ༈ /gnyis pa sgyu lus chags sdang rang grol ni/ rang nyid 'khor lo bde mchog sku mdog mthing*// rdo rje dril bsnol phyag rgya drug gis brgyan// thor tshugs zla phyed sna tshogs rdo rjes mtshan// mgo phreng do shal stag lpags sham (218)thabs can// g.yon bskum g.yas brkyang 'jigs byed dus mtshan mnan// phag mo dmar mo gri thod 'dzin pas 'khyud/

me dpung dbus su pad nyi'i gdan la gsal// spyi bor gdan bzhi brtsegs la bla ma dag byed stong ra ltar gsal/ rdo rje 'chang du bsgom na sngon po bya/ de'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ phyogs dus kyi bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems dpa' bo mkha' 'gro dge 'dun chos skyong thams cad spyan drangs te thim pas bla ma nyid dkon mchog kun 'dus kyi bdag nyid yin la yin bzhin par gyur/ mtshan thos kyang 'khor ba ngan song las sgrol na gsol ba btab na lta ci smos snyam pa sogs mos gus drag po dang*/ rigs drug sems can sogs snod bcud thams cad las gsol 'debs kyi sgra 'ur dir dir byed par bsams la/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i ngo bo bla ma rin po che/ sems can thams cad kyi don tu bdag gis bdag 'dzin blos thong bar mdzad du gsol/ dgos med rgyud la skye bar mdzad du gsol/ sgyu lus 'byongs par mdzad du gsol/ rmi lam 'byongs par mdzad du gsol/ 'od gsal phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub da lta nyid du myur ba nyid du 'dug sa 'di nyid du thob par mdzad du gsol/ zhes gsol ba drag tu btab nas bla ma rang la bstim/ de nas dmigs pa tsam la thab par bsngags pa'i gnad brgyad ni/ rang lus lha sku stong sang nge ba'i smad cha'i nang du chos 'byung dkar po 'od kyi rang bzhin gru gsum pa'i zur gcig lte ba dang*/ zur gnyis mkhal khung gnyis la bstan pa/ rtsa ba phra ba gsang phrag dang kha gdengs g.yel ba gyen/ de la sems yud tsam gtad/ gnad dang po'o// de'i nang du rigs drug gi sems can (219)dpag tu med pa so so'i lus dang byed las bcas byung nas chos 'byung khrig gis gang bar bsgom/ rang nyid 'gro drug so sor skye ba'i las dang bag chags kyi rang gzugs su shar ba'o snyam pa dang*/ lte 'og tu 'gro drug gi snang ba 'char byed rtsa yig yod pa nyid gzugs su shar ba'o snyam pa'ang dran tsam bya/

gnyis pa'o// mkha' khyab kyi sems can dmigs yul du byas/ sems kyi rtsi kha lte ba'i rigs drug la gtad de 'di rnams snang ni snang*/ bden ni mi bden/ bden med sgyu ma lta bu/ rmi lam lta bu yin snyam drag tu bsgom/ gsum pa'o// 'di rnams bden med la bden par bzung nas 'khor bar 'khyams pa snying re rje snyam pa'i snying rje lhang lhang bya/ bzhi pa'o// 'di rnams 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal las bla mas nges par bskyab tu gsol/ pha bla ma rang mkhyen snyam du blo 'gel/ lnga pa'o// de rnams gcig yal gnyis yal rim gyis chos 'byung stong sang nge song pa la sems gtad/ drug pa'o// de nas gtad so ci'ang med pa'i 'dzin med ngang du shig ger bzhag /bdun pa'o// de la ma gnas na rang gzhan snod bcud thams cad med bzhin tu snang ba sgyu ma lta bur thag bcad/ thun mtshams su'ang mi rtag /mos gus/ sgyu ma'i 'dun pa gsum po gang rung dang ma bral bas ting nge 'dzin spel bar bya/ nad gdon sogs rkyen bzang ngan thams cad lam du khyer tshul gzhung las shes par bya'o// mdo rgyud kun gyis bstan bya'i bcud// bsgom na 'khor ba'i 'khrul 'khor 'jig /yon tan drug po shugs la 'char// snang stong rab 'byams e ma ho/ ༈ /gsum pa rmi lam nying 'khrul rang dag la (220)gnyis te/ dang po bzung ba ni/ rang lus yi dam du gsal zhing spyi bor bla ma bsgom pa sogs sgyu lus skabs ltar dang*/ gsol 'debs kyang tshig rkang gsum po de ka ltar las/ sgyu lus sogs kyi tshab tu/ rmi lam zin par mdzad du gsol/ zhes mtha' bsgyur nas gsol ba drag tu btab pas/ bla ma 'od du zhu rang la thim/ rang lus lha sku gsal stong du shar ba'i stong ra'i dbus su rtsa dbu ma dkar po shel gyi ka ba lta bu/ yas sna spyi bo dang mas sna gsang gnas su zug pa/ de'i nang gi yar sner haṃ dkar po mgo bo thur du lta ba/ mar sner hūm̐ yig dmar po mgo bo gyen tu lta ba bsgom/

dbu ma yar mar phra zhing rked pa ldir ba nya dbyibs lta bur bsgom pa'ang gsungs mod/ blo rig dang bstun pa'i tshe na lag ngar tsam dang chung na sba smyug tsam bsgom pa rang legs/ dbu ma sbom na thig le 'khor bde ba yin kyang phra sbom can de cung mi legs/ gang shar thams cad la spyir bden med dang*/ sgos rmi lam du shes pa'i rtsis bzung nas bsgom pa kho na gal che/ de nas spyi bo'i haṃ las thig le dkar po sran ma tsam zhig hril gyis chad/ snying gar sleb/ gti mug dag /snying ga yan chad bde yang phyod kyi song*/ mar sne'i hūm̐ las thig le dmar po sran ma tsam zhig chad/ snying gar sleb/ 'dod chags dag /khog smad bde yang phyod kyi song*/ dkar dmar gnyis snying gar 'dzom/ zhe sdang rang dag la song*/ snying ga'i thad bde yang phyod kyi song bar bsam/ bden med dang rmi lam gyi 'dun pa drag po'i ngang snying ga'i thad kyi dbu ma'i thig le gnyis po 'bros 'dod kyi tshul du g.yas bskor g.yon bskor rang gi blo (221)la gang bder 'khor ba la sems gtad/ bum dbang gi gnad do// ji zhig na gcig rjes gcig zin gyis reg tsam reg tsam par mos/ gsang dbang ngo*// de nas reg pas lus sems bde phril phril song bar mos/ sher dbang ngo*/ mthar gcig la gcig thim gtad med du yal ba'i ngang dmigs med du bzhag /dbang bzhi pa'i gnad dang 'brel ba'o// bar bar du bden med dang rmi lam yin snyam pa'i 'dun pa kha shas re drag tu bya/ thun mtshams su mi rtag pa/ mos gus/ rmi lam gyi 'dun pa dang mi 'bral bar bya/ zin pa la brtan pa thob nas/ gnyis pa rmi lam sbyong ba ni/ skabs 'dir 'dun pas sbyong ba ste/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor sogs sngar bzhin la gsol 'debs skabs/ rmi lam 'byongs bar mdzad du gsol/ zhes bsgyur/ 'dun pa kho nas rtsal nges med du sbyangs ste rmi lam gyi yid lus la ci sbyang sbyang yin snyam pa'i 'dun pa rgyun chags dang*/

ka ba rtsig pa sogs la zang thal/ bu ga phra mo la 'dzul zhing me chu gcan gzan g.yang sa sogs ya nga'i rigs la thog brdzis/ mkha' la 'phur zhing sa la 'dzul ba/ khyad par ngo tsha skyug bro sogs rnam rtog chod dka' ba'i rigs la res thog brdzis/ res bden med/ res zlog bsgom gyis nyin mo 'dun pas sbyang zhing mtshan snang la dngos su sbyang ngo*// spel ba sogs gzhung las shes/ ma zin na spog chog /zin pa brtan byed/ 'byams gcod la sogs pa gal pa che'i gdams ngag rnams kyang man ngag las shes par bya'o// rmi lam lta bu'i chos rnams la// rtag tu rmi lam ltar shes na// rigs drug srid pa'i mngal kha stong*// gsal stong lha sku rang shar (222)ro// bzhi pa 'od gsal gti mug rang sangs la/ sngon 'gro'i tshul du mi rtag pa dung pa bsgom zhing skyo shas bskyed/ dngos gzhi 'od gsal bzung ba ni/ rang bde mchog tu gsal ba'i spyi bor gdan bzhi rdzogs kyi steng du/ rtsa ba'i bla ma ral pa'i thor tshugs rus rgyan stag lpags sogs dur khrod chas brgyad kyis brgyan pa/ rdo rje 'chang du bsgom na yang he ru ka zhi ma khro spyan gsum pa bsgom/ gsol 'debs snga ma'i mtha'/ 'od gsal zin par mdzad du gsol/ zhes bsgyur la mos gus chen pos gsol ba drag tu 'debs/ lus kyi dbus su rtsa dbu ma dkar po// de'i snying ga'i thad du padma dkar po 'dab bzhi dang zla ba'i steng du rtsa ba'i bla ma dkar la 'od zer 'phro ba tshon gang ba/ thugs kar thig le dkar po sran ma tsam 'od 'phro ba la sems gtad de mnyam par bzhag /de las 'od 'phros/ bla ma'i sku khra sa le khyab/ thugs rgyud bde bas gang*/ sku las 'od zer byung*/ rang lus khyab/ rang lus ba spu'i bu ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ snang ba thams cad khra gsal gyis khyab par bsgom/ thugs ka'i thig le la sems gtad pa dang 'od zer spro ba de ka yang yang bskyar/ bar bar shes pa rang bab tu bzhag pas skabs rer bde gsal mi rtog pa shugs 'byung du byung na re dogs med par bskyang*/

gnyid du 'gro khar thugs ka'i thig le'am hūm̐ dngul chu'i mdog lta bu la sems gtad/ thun mtshams su mi rtag pa dang bla ma'i mos gus/ khyad par sku gsum lam khyer gyi 'jog stangs zhes pa/ mig glang po che'i lta stangs ha re bzhag /shes pa klod/ gang shar rang ngo skyong*/ snang ba sna tshogs kyi gsal cha sprul sku/ rang ngo shes pa'i (223)stong cha chos sku/ de gnyis dbyer med pa'i rang rig rang gsal longs skur shes pas lam du khyer/ chos brgyad kyi a 'thas bshigs/ rnam rtog rang gar ma shor bar rang grol rang dag cig thams cad du gal che/ bsre ba dang rjes gegs sel bogs 'don sogs gzhung las shes/ kun rtog 'pho ba dbyings su sbyang*// ma rig 'khor ba'i rdzun phug gtibs// snang bcas snang med 'od gsal nyid// lag gtod gdams pa'i snying khrag go/ ༈ /lnga pa 'pho ba ma sgoms sangs rgyas ni/ skabs 'dir lhan thabs kyi man ngag ye shes skar khung ma la byed de/ rang lus lhar gsal spyi bor bla ma bsgom pa sogs sgyu lus skabs ltar la/ gsol 'debs mthar/ bar dor sangs rgyas bar mdzad du gsol// zhes bsgyur/ bla ma rang la thim/ lus kyi stong ra'i nang du rtsa dbu ma lag dar ram sba lcag tsam dkar po// mar sne gsang gnas su kha zum zhing*/ yar sne spyi bo'i tshangs bug tu had por yod pa/ dbu ma'i lte ba'i thad du chos 'byung dkar po rtsa ba thur dang gdengs ka gyen bstan/ zur gcig mdun dang gnyis g.yas g.yon tu bstan pa'i dbus gang la'ang ma reg pa'i a dkar po phra la gsal ba 'phar la khad pa zhig bsam/ rlung ro lan gsum bsal/ bum can shugs drag la yun thung ba zhig bzung*/ a la sems gtad/ 'og rlung 'then/ lto ba sgal tshigs la cung bcer bas a de cung 'phar nas sngar shul du bab/ de las drag par bcer bas sngar las mtho tsam 'phar sngar shul bsdad/ slar drag tu bcer ba dang mnyam chos 'byung gi kha thag ces brdab pas rlung gi shugs (224)kyis a de mda' 'phangs pa bzhin tu dbu ma'i lam brgyud tshangs bug nas thon/

nam mkha' mthon por sleb nas yal bar bsam la dbyings rig nam mkha' gsum 'dres pa la had de bzhag /de ltar lan bdun tsam bskyar/ 'bebs pa ni nam mkhar a dkar po zhig lam gyis grub pa tshangs bug nas zhugs/ dbu mar dal bus bab/ lte ba'i chos 'byung du brtan cing brjid dang ldan par 'dug pas lus bde phril gyis byung bar bsam/ de thun chung gcig yin/ thog mar sbyong skabs rtags ma thon bar de nyid yang yang bsgom/ rgyun tu dmigs pa tshar re las mi dgos/ thun mtshams su dbu ma'i yar sne zum par bsgom mo// las la bzang ngan ma mchis par// mkha' spyod dag pa'i zhing du skyel// zhag bdun tsam gyis gtan don 'grub// dman kyang 'di tsam 'bad na mtshar/ ༈ /drug pa bar do rgyal ba longs sku ni/ sngon 'gro snga ma ltar la/ bar do longs sku thob par mdzad du gsol// zhes gsol 'debs kyi mtha' bsgyur/ bla ma rang la thim/ rang dang snang ba thams cad srid pa bar do dngos yin snyam pa'i 'dun pa drag po sbyang*/ 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal/ chags sdang gi nyes dmigs la skyo shas bskyed/ bar do'i skabs 'dir rnam rtog skad cig mas gtan gyi bde sdug tshabs po che byed pas ma 'khrul bar ci nas bya snyam pa'i ngang*/ mdun tu chos 'byung sngon po rtsa ba phra zhing gdengs ka gyen tu bstan pa zhig bsgom/ 'di ma rtogs pa la ma'i mngal/ rtogs pa rnams la 'og min chos kyi dbyings kyi pho brang yin snyam du bsam/ rang nyid de'i dbus su phyin pas hūm̐ yig sngon po che zhing 'od 'bar bar gyur/ de las (225)'od 'phros chos 'byung la phog pas/ 'gro ba rigs drug gi mngal du sngar skyes pa dang*/ da ltar skye ba'i lan chags dang bag chags thams cad sbyangs/ ma 'ongs pa'i skye sgo bkag /skye gnas gzhan gsum gyi bag chags kyang zhor la dag par bsam/ hūm̐ de yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid 'khor lo bde mchog lhan skyes su gsal ba'i spyi bor bla ma gdan bzhi rdzogs kyi steng du bsgom ste/

bar dor longs sku thob par mdzad du gsol// zhes gsol ba rtse gcig btab/ gzugs snang thams cad bde mchog yab yum/ sgra ru grags tshad yi ge bdun pa/ yid kyi dran rtog thams cad rmi lam sgyu ma'i ngang tshul bden par ma grub par thag bcad/ chos 'byung gi g.yas zur du zhe sdang skye ba'i yul dang pho thams cad 'khor lo sdom pa/ g.yon zur du 'dod chags skye ba'i yul dang mo thams cad rdo rje phag mor gyur nas 'khod par mos la/ mchod pa bzhi rdzogs su phul/ bud med kyis bsgom na chags sdang skye ba'i yul go brje/ mos gus dang*/ lha sku dang*/ thams cad bar dor thag bcad cing de'ang bden med du shes pa ni rgyun chags su gal che'o// chu ka chad pa'i yur chu bzhin// bar do'i rnam rtog kha bsgyur na// yang srid srid par mi 'jug pas// da lta nyid nas goms 'dris gces// de dag kyang rtsa ba'i chos bzhi la thog mar nyams myong gi sne re ma rnyed par bsgom/ de nas yongs rdzogs su bsgom na snga dro gtum mo// nyin gung sgyu lus/ dgongs mo rmi lam/ mtshan mo 'od gsal/ yan lag gi chos 'pho ba dang bar do skabs su gang bab tu bsgom/ chos drug kar nyams su len mi nus na rang gis (226)gang 'dod de khol 'don byed nas bsgom/ skyabs sems stong ra thams cad kyi sngon tu 'gro dgos/ gtum mo kho na bsgom 'dod na lus gnad me'i stong ra rlung theng gsum bzhi tsam dang*/ gtum mo zas su za ba ci nus su bsgom/ rjes srid pa'i dbang zhu ba tshar gcig byed/ de kho nas thun bzhi'am drug sogs bcad/ gzhan la'ang des 'gre'o// de dag gis ni khrid yig ma bu rnams su dngos su bstan pa'i chos drug snying por bsdus pa bshad zin to/ ༈ /rtsa ba'i gnyis pa khyad par gyi man ngag las 'byung ba ni/ rtsa ba'i chos bzhi stan thog gcig rang du bsgom na/ skyabs sems stong ra yan sngar ltar la/ spyi bab nas bla ma'i rnal 'byor zhig bya ste/

bsgom tshul stong ra bzhin la/ gsol 'debs ni gdung shugs drag pos/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus ba'i ngo bo bla ma rin po che/ sems can thams cad kyi don tu bdag gis bdag 'dzin blos thongs par mdzad du gsol/ dgos med rgyud la skye bar mdzad du gsol/ sgyu lus rmi lam 'byongs par mdzad du gsol/ 'od gsal phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub da lta nyid du myur ba nyid du 'dug sa 'di nyid du thob par mdzad du gsol/ zhes pas gsol ba drag tu btab/ 'di skabs bla ma dkon mchog kun 'dus su shes pa dang*/ sems can thams cad bsam 'og tu bcug pa tsam las skyabs yul tshur bstims ba dang*/ 'gro drug gis gsol ba 'debs pa'i dmigs pa mi dgos/ mthar bla ma rang la bstim ste mnyam par bzhag ༈ /gtum mo stan thog gcig ma ni/ lus gnad rnam snang chos bdun spyi ltar las/ lta stangs thad kar blta/ (227)lag mthil gnyis kyis pus mo mnan/ rang nyid rdo rje phag mo bzhugs tshul sogs rang lus dang mthun pa/ rgyan dang gdan sogs spyi mthun bsgom/ lus kyi nang stong sang nge ba'i dbus su ro rkyang spangs pa'i rtsa dbu ma mtshan nyid bzhi ldan ring thung sogs gong ltar la/ lte 'og sor bzhi'i nang du raṃ dmar nag nas 'bru tsam/ lte ba'i thad kyi nang du nyi gdan sran chung tsam la gnas ba'i a shad dmar ser sor gang tsam phra mo zhig bsgom de rtsa ba'i bla ma'i ngo bor yin snyam mos gus dung ba bya/ dbu ma'i yas snar haṃ dkar mgo 'thur bstan/ steng gi nam mkha' bla ma dkar la 'dzum zhing gzi brjid 'bar bar bsam/ rlung ro dgu phugs su 'bud la sbyor ba bzhi ldan gyi rlung drag tu bzung bas/ rlung nyid dbu ma'i g.yon nas mdung tshugs su song*/ mas sna nas zhugs te raṃ bus pas me lce dmar nag sor bzhi 'bar/ bla ma'i ngo bo a shad bskul/ de las me dmar ser 'ur gyis 'bar/ spyi bo'i haṃ bsros/

me lces tshangs bug nas thon te rgya cher 'bar ba'i rtse mo las mchod pa bzhi rdzogs su sprul nas bla ma mchod/ me lce'i 'od las bde drod kyi mchod pa dang bcas pas mnyes par byas/ sangs rgyas kun 'dus kyi ngo bo de'ang byang chub sems kyi bdud rtsir zhu nas me lce dang lhan cig tshangs bug nas byon te spyi bo'i haṃ la 'dres bas thig le'i rgyun nar gyis bab/ mgrin par sleb/ dga' ba dang bum dbang*/ snying gar sleb/ mchog dga' dang gsang dbang*/ lte ba'i a shad la thim/ khyad dga' sher dbang*/ de las kyang bdud rtsi bab pa raṃ la thim/ lhan skyes dang dbang bzhi pa'o zhes don dran/ slar 'bar 'dzag skra shad (228)'dzings pa gtum mo dkyus ltar bsgom pa las/ raṃ dang a shad kyi me gcig tu 'dres pa 'bar ba dang*/ thig le 'dzag pa a shad brgyud raṃ la thim par bsgom pa'o// 'di ni gtum mo zas su za ba/ byin rlabs bla ma'i gtum mo// srid pa'i dbang zhu ba gsum ga dmigs pa gcig la dril bas byin rlabs dang gnad shin tu che gsungs/ skabs 'dir rlung drag tu bus pa'i phyi 'dzin khong 'dren drag po'i ngang 'bar ba la sems gtad pa dang*/ drag tu rngubs te thur sel gyi sgo gnyis la gzir zhing zhu ba la sems gtad/ thams cad du sems nam mkha' la yas su bcug /lto ba phyir bkyed nas lus gcu zhing rtsal sprugs drag po byed pa dang*/ hal zhes brjod pa na rlung sbyor gcig la thabs lam yongs su rdzogs pa shin tu gsang ba'i man ngag nye brgyud do// thog ma nas stan gcig ma 'di bsgom pa min/ gzhung gi thabs lam la drod tshad rnyed nas rgyun khyer dang bog 'don tu 'di nyid bsgom par bya'o/ ༈ /sgyu lus la/ rtsa ba'i bla ma spyi bo snying ga sogs su bsgom yang rung*/ gang na bzhugs pa'i phyogs sam mkha' khyab tu bzhugs pa la gsol ba btab kyang chog ste/ pha bla ma/ pha bla ma/ bla ma rang mkhyen/ drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma khyed la gsol ba 'debs so// zhes mos gdung drag po snying la zug pa bsgoms nas de'i ngang du klod la bzhag

/rang lha skur lam tsam gsal btab/ rang gzhan snang ba thams cad la bsam ste/ 'di thams cad med bzhin tu 'khrul ba'i snang ba yin/ bzang ngan chags sdang chos brgyad sogs la a 'thas kyi dgag sgrub byed pa re 'khrul/ gtad pa (229)ci yod/ sgyu ma rmi lam rang yin snyam drag tu sbyangs pas rtsis gdab med par song ba de kar bzo med du bskyang*/ de ma thag rang lus lhar gsal ba'am tha mal yin kyang rung ste lte 'og chos 'byung man chad dkyus ltar bsgoms pas dbang po rab 'bring tha ma'i nyams len gyi gnad gcig tu 'dus pa'o// rmi lam la/ bzung ba dkyus ltar rang zin thig le dbang bzhi'i gnad tshar gsum tsam 'jur nas bsgom pa'i rjes su/ rang gzhan snod bcud dgra gnyen longs spyod sogs la bden med kyi 'dun pa drag tu sbyang*/ de ka'i ngang gang shar bzo med du 'jog /de nyid yang yang goms par bya/ sbyang ba'ang gong ltar la sgyu ma lta bu'i 'dun pa dang rang bab kyi 'gros skyong ba gnad ltag par che/ yul snang gtan la dbab 'dod na/ snying gar hūm̐ dkar po dwangs gsal 'od 'phro ba bsgom/ rmi lam sgyu ma'i 'dun pa dang yul snang blta 'dod drag tu bya/ hūm̐ las 'od thag pa lta bu rgyangs kyi 'phros/ gang blta bar 'dod pa'i yul lam dngos po de 'od kyi zhags pas drangs nas snying ga'i hūm̐ la thim/ hūm̐ gi 'od kyis snang ba thams cad khra chem gyis gsal ba la sems gtad/ skabs 'dir bum can bsgom pa gal che/ sgyu lus rmi lam gyi dge sbyor skye ba la bsags rgyab yod pa zhig dgos te/ ma zin 'byams dang gol sa gsum// bsod nams tshogs kyis bcad par bya// zhes 'byung ngo*/ ༈ /'od gsal la/ gong bshad de dmigs pa'i mthil yin mod/ des cis kyang ma zin na rno khyad ni/ lus nang dbu ma'i mar sner a dkar po bsam/ steng rlung nan nan/ 'og rlung 'then 'then byas pas (230)a de gsang ba'i rtsa bar lhan lhan song*/

gsang ba'i rtsa lam nas dkyus kyog kyog pa'i ngang nor bu'i nang du kha dog sngon po 'od 'tsher ba zhig tu gyur/ mgo nang bstan tu log /shugs drag pos phyi la 'gro tshad pa la bu ga dogs por ma shong bas lhan lhan 'dug pa la sems yud cig drag tu gtad/ yang de ka'i snang ba ma 'gag tsam la gtad de bzhag /de nyid yang yang bsgom/ 'di bud med kyis bsgom na dbu ma'i mar sne lte 'og sor brgyad tsam du sleb pa'i mar sne de la bsgom/ gzhan 'dra/ 'dzin pa la lhag par zab po/ ༈ /'pho ba ni/ lus nang dbu ma dkar po'i mar sner a dkar po// spyi bo'i tshangs bug had por yod par bsgom/ rlung phyir 'bud pa dang lhan cig lte 'og sor bzhi'i a de dbu ma'i lam dang tshangs bug brgyud/ nam mkha'i dbus su mda' 'phangs pa bzhin tu song nas dbyings su yal/ cung zad mnyam par bzhag /yang a de nam mkhar byung ba tshangs bug nas babs te dbu ma'i mar sner phyin par bsam/ 'di la 'gro 'ong spel ma bsgom pa las sgo dgag pa sogs mi dgos gsungs/ 'di la'ang 'chug med mkha' spyod dam/ ye shes skar khungs ma sngon tu 'gro dgos pa shes par bya'o/ ༈ /bar do'i skabs gong gsal gzhung khrid ltar las/ chags sdang gi yul chos 'byung nang du lhar gsal ba'i skor de mi bya bar/ 'gro ba rigs drug gi gnas dang*/ gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya bzang ngan thams cad la sgyu ma dang bar do'i 'dun pa sbyang*/ mngal sgong gi gnyis sbyor sogs gsal gdab/ bar do'i 'dun pas yi dam yab yum du bsgyur/ (231)de'ang sgyu mar shes pas zhen med kyi ngang skyong bar bya'o// de ltar chos drug stan thog gcig tu nyams su len tshul zhal rgyun ma chad pa dang*/ byin rlabs bka' bab kyi gdams pa 'ga' zhig ye shes kyi mkha' 'gros rje btsun kun dga' grol mchog la dngos su stsal ba'i nye brgyud ches zab pa bcas smos zin to// 'di nyid la rtags thon rang byed na khrid chen rgyas pa dmigs rkang re bdun ma'am/

'bring po dmigs rkang bcu bdun ma tsam la rtsa bar bzung*/ dmigs pa bka' rgya ma'i rigs rnams skabs dang bstun te len/ nyams myong gi sne zin nas 'dir bstan tsam gyis chog shes par byas na shin tu legs shing*/ 'dir bstan ma bu gnyis la'ang gnad thams cad tshang bar yod pas nyams len nus na 'di tsam gyis kyang dgos don 'grub par yod/ yang sgyu lus rmi lam kho na lta bu khol 'don sgro na de dag stan thog gcig ma zur du 'byung ba las shes par bya'o// thams cad la spyir gces pa'i gnad du/ rtsa ba'i bla ma dkon mchog rtsa gsum kun 'dus/ yan lag gi bla ma gzhan thams cad de'i rnam 'phrul du shes pas sangs rgyas las kyang lhag pa'i mos gus ltem rkyang med pa ni spyir gsang sngags lam gyi srog rtsa med thabs med cing*/ khyad par dpal ldan rmog lcog pa'i zhal nas/ 'od gsal gtan la 'bebs pa sgyu ma/ sgyu ma gtan la 'bebs pa rmi lam/ rmi lam gtan la 'bebs pa dad 'dun/ dad 'dun ston byed bla ma/ des na rtsa ba'i bla ma la thams cad rag las par gsungs pas thabs lam skyong ba la shin tu gal che ba des go nus shing*/ rang sems stong pa chos sku/ snang ba sprul sku/ dbyer med rang rig rang gsal longs (232)skur shes pas nyin mtshan kun tu ma yengs dran pa'i rtsis bzung nas lam du khyer/ de'i ngang du rlung bum can nam/ 'jam rlung ngam bar rlung ci nus 'bad pas gsal stong bde stong du shar ba kun sgyu ma lta bur shes shing*/ de'ang 'dzin med phyag rgya chen po'i ngang du bzhag ste mnyam bzhag gi nyams len rjes thob spyod lam thams cad dang bsres bas myur du brtan pa thob par 'gyur la/ rtag tu kun byang sems mi nyams pa dang*/ rnam rtog tha mal du mi 'chor ba'ang rnal 'byor pa'i dam tshig go /de ltar bsgoms pas lus ngag yid kyi nyams 'jam rtsub mtho dman bde sdug ji ltar byung yang dga' sdug spang blang re dogs med par sgyu ma rmi lam du shes nas byung rgyal du bskyang ba ni gegs sel gyi mchog yin zhing*/

dge sbyor legs par skyes pa sogs bzang ngan ci byung bla ma'i thugs rje kho nar shes pas gsol 'debs mos gus kho na la lam gyi gzhi 'cha' ba dang*/ ma rtogs pa'i sems can ris med pa la byams snying rje 'ba' zhig bskyed pa'i pan sems kyis dus 'da' ba ni bogs 'don dang 'gro don gyi rtsa ba'o// de ltar bsgoms pas ji zhig na ched gtad kyi rtsol ba ma byas par sems bde gsal mi rtog pa'i 'od gsal mtha' dbus med par rang shar ba dang*/ bskyed 'dod kyi blo mngon 'gyur ba med bzhin tu lha sku'i snang ba gsal dwangs wa ler shar ba ni sgyu lus kyi lha sku rang shar zhes bya ste zab gsal dbyer med 'phags pa'i mngon rtogs dang chos mtshungs pa'o// gzhan yang mkhas grub khyung yo'i zhal nas/ sgyu lus rmi lam la sogs pa'i chos 'di rnams nyams su len tsa na/ rmi lam mi 'tsham pa dang*/ ḍā kis gzugs sna tshogs su bsgyur nas ltas dang cho (333)'phrul sna tshogs ston tu 'ong bas de la 'jigs mi dgos/ lar dus dang rnam pa thams cad du nga rang gis byin gyis brlab pa yin gsungs/ dbon ston skyer sgang pa la yi dam lhas gdams ngag gi gnas bsdus su stsal ba/ sgyu lus bden med gnad yin a 'thas bshigs// rmi lam 'dun pa'i gnad yin lam du khyer// 'od gsal mos gus gnad yin gsol bas thob// gzhan don snying rje'i gnad yin phyogs 'dzin spongs// zhes pa'i gnad bzhi la gdams ngag gi rkang thams cad tshang zhing*/ 'gro 'dug /'pho bskyas/ blo sna/ log lta mang po ste dge sbyor gyi sad bzhi la ma bskur ba nyams su blang na da lta dus snyig cing bstan pa'i gzugs brnyan tu gyur pa'i stobs kyis gzhung nas bshad tshod kyi mngon rtags chos phal cher la 'byung dka' yang*/ 'dir ni ye shes mkha' 'gro rnam pa gnyis kyis slob ma yang slob brgyud pa dang bcas pa rnams la thugs rjes bzung zhing*/

dag pa bde stong gi mkha' spyod du 'khrid pa khyung po nyid la lung bstan zhing*/ khyung po nyid kyis kyang*/ nga las lhag pa nam yang med de nga dang mnyam pa'ang med la/ bdag gi brgyud 'dzin thams cad kyang kun las khyad par 'phags pas na/ bsags pa yang rab 'ba' zhig 'byung bar 'gyur ro zhes bden par gsungs pa ltar/ brgyud pa'i bla ma rin chen rnam lnga sogs phal mo che skye ba gcig gis thogs pa'i byang sems mthong thos dran reg thams cad ngan song las skyob nus par lung bstan thob cing chos brgyud ma chad bar du nyams rtogs skye bar byin gyis rlob pa grub thob so sos zhal gyis bzhes la/ bdag gi bla ma grub pa'i dbang po karma gzhan (334)phan 'od zer yan chad chos drug gi nyams myong gzhung nas bshad chod skyes shing*/ yi dam lha'i zhal mthong*/ bden gnyis dbyer med kyi rtogs pa mngon tu gyur pa tshig rkyang gi bshad sgros gtsang gtsang tsam ma yin pa blo gtad thub pa'i gdams ngag byin rlabs kyi drod ma yal ba yin/ spyir yang nyams su len pa lta ci smos/ dad pas mthong ba'am lan cig thos pa tsam gyis kyang mchog thun mong gi dngos grub 'byung bar the tshom med pa/ nyes pa'i skyon dang bral zhing legs pa'i yon tan rdzogs pa/ lo zla tsam gyis 'tshang rgya nges ba'i gser chos gcig brgyud ma zhes brgyud pa nas brgyud par bsngags pa yin te/ grub chen khyung po'i zhal nas/ nga'i gdams ngag 'di gzhan las khyad par 'phags/ mgo byin na mgos phan thogs/ bar byin na bar gyis phan thogs/ gsham byin na gsham gyis phan thogs pa yin pas the tshom yid gnyis ma byed par brtson 'grus chen pos nyams su longs shig /bla ma sangs rgyas dngos las zhus pa/ ḍā ki dngos su 'du ba/ yon tan dngos su skye ba/ brgyud pa'i bka' babs dang ldan pa/ ḍā ki'i byin rlabs dang ldan pa/ gdams ngag gi nus pa dang ldan pa 'di nyams su longs shig

/dbang po rab rnam smin/ 'bring bag chags/ tha ma yang bar dor 'tshang mi rgya mi srid pa yin no// bdag gis bka' babs dang gdams ngag gi gnad 'di lta bu rgya bod gang na'ang med par thag chod pa yin no// zhes sogs yang yang bsngags shing grub mtha' ris med pas bsngags pa'i me tog 'thor bas grags pa'i ba dan srid rtser bsnyegs bzhin pa lags mod/ brgyud pa mar la bab pa na gser chos 'di rnams yang na bka' chad/ yang na (3335)tshong 'dus kyi 'o ma bzhin tu 'gro bar lung gis bstan pa mngon tu gyur te ltar snang dang bslad can mang pos gzugs brnyan tu gyur pa na/ grol mchog zhabs la nye brgyud kyi bka' babs shing kun mkhyen sgrol ba'i mgon pos man ngag bar ma chad pa'i gnad dang 'khrul med ye shes kyi gzigs pas rin chen rnam bdun gyi dgongs pa phyin ci ma log par gsal bar mdzad pa'i snying po ni 'di kho na'o// shin tu snyigs mar gyur na yang*// gser chos 'di 'dzin grub brnyes kyis// rjes su bzung ba skal pa bzang*// yon tan bsam gyin dang re spro// 'di bris nongs pa gang mchis pa// bla ma sangs rgyas spyan sdar bshags// nyams su mi len kha khyer bas// spyad na ḍā ki'i chad pa 'byung*// 'di mthong thos dang dran pa yang*// bde chen zhing du brdzus skyes te// grub chen khyung po yab sras kyis// rjes bzung mkha' spyod che 'grub shog /ces pa 'di'ang rdo rje slob dpon chen po'i go 'phang gdod nas grub pa 'jigs bral mkhyen brtse'i 'od zer can gyis snga phyir bka' stsal gnang ba ltar/ khyung rigs su skyes shing shangs chos la mos pas spyod pa yon tan rgya mtshos dpal spungs yang khrod bde chen 'od gsal gling du ḍā ki 'du ba'i dus tshes grub sbyor dang ldan pa'i snga char grub par bgyis pa dpal ldan shangs pa'i bka' brgyud sa steng khyab pa'i rgyur gyur cig /dge legs 'phel/// /(336)
